'''Science and Research''' was a division of the [[Eternal Alliance]] founded by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] to coordinate the research into [[Zakuul]]an technology.<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />
